question: Is God good to all, or just a few?

answers.answer: God is good to all
answers.answerExplanation:
The LORD [is] good to all: and his tender mercies [are] over all his works. (Psalms 145:9)

The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy. (Psalms 145:20)

answers.answer: God is merciless and destructive
answers.answerExplanation: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them. (Jeremiah 13:14)

question: Is God a god of war or peace?

answers.answerExplanation: The LORD [is] a man of war: the LORD [is] his name. (Exodus 15:3)

answers.answer: God is a god of peace

question: Who is the father of Joseph (husband of Mary)?

answers.answer: Jacob
answers.answerExplanation: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ. (Matthew 1:16)

question: Who visited Jesus' empty tomb?

answers.answer: Mary Magdalene, Mary mother of James, and Salome
answers.answerExplanation: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the [mother] of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him. (Mark 16:1)

answers.answer: Mary Magdalene alone
answers.answerExplanation: The first [day] of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre. (John 20:1)

question: Is Jesus equal to or lesser than God the Father?

answers.answer: Jesus and the Father are equal
answers.answerExplanation: I and [my] Father are one. (John 10:30)

answers.answer: The Father is greater than Jesus
answers.answerExplanation: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come [again] unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I. (John 14:28)

question: Which were created first, beasts or man?

answers.answer: Beasts were created before man
answers.answerExplanation:

And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth. (Genesis 1:26)

answers.answer: Man was created before beasts
answers.answerExplanation:
And the LORD God said, [It is] not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him. (Genesis 2:18)

And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought [them] unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that [was] the name thereof. (Genesis 2:19)

question: How many stalls and horsemen did Solomon have?

answers.answer: Forty thousand stalls and twelve thousand horsemen
answers.answerExplanation: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen. (1 Kings 4:26)

answers.answer: Four thousand stalls and twelve thousand horsemen
answers.answerExplanation: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem. (2 Chronicles 9:25)

question: Is it folly to be wise or not?

answers.answer: Wisdom is the most important thing
answers.answerExplanation: Wisdom [is] the principal thing; [therefore] get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding. (Proverbs 4:7)

answers.answer: Wisdom brings grief and sorrow
answers.answerExplanation: For in much wisdom [is] much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow. (Ecclesiastes 1:18)

answers.answer: God will destroy the wisdom of the wise
answers.answerExplanation: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent. (1 Corinthians 1:19)

question: Was Jesus conceived by human or divine means?

answers.answer: Jesus was a physical descendant of David
answers.answerExplanation: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne; (Acts 2:30)

answers.answer: Jesus was conceived by the Holy Ghost
answers.answerExplanation: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost. (Matthew 1:18)

question: Are children punished for the sins of their parents?

answers.answer: Yes, children are punished for their parents' sins

answers.answer: No, each person dies for their own sin
answers.answerExplanation: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers: every man shall be put to death for his own sin. (Deuteronomy 24:16)

question: Do rabbits chew their cud?

answers.answer: The Bible claims rabbits chew their cud, but they do not
answers.answerExplanation: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he [is] unclean unto you. (Leviticus 11:6)

question: Were fowl created from water or from the ground?

answers.answer: Fowl came from the waters

answers.answer: Fowl were formed from the ground
answers.answerExplanation: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought [them] unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that [was] the name thereof. (Genesis 2:19)

question: Can visual stimuli during conception affect the appearance of offspring?

answers.answer: The Bible claims striped rods caused striped offspring

question: What is the shape of the earth?

answers.answer: The earth is a circle (sphere)
answers.answerExplanation: [It is] he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof [are] as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in: (Isaiah 40:22)

answers.answer: All kingdoms can be seen from a high mountain, implying a flat earth
answers.answerExplanation: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them; (Matthew 4:8)

question: Do snakes eat dust?

answers.answer: The Bible claims snakes eat dust, but they do not
answers.answerExplanation: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou [art] cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life: (Genesis 3:14)

question: Is the earth supported or unsupported?

answers.answer: The earth has foundations

question: How does the water cycle work according to the Bible?

answers.answer: Rivers flow to the sea and return to their source (accurate cycle)
answers.answerExplanation: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea [is] not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again. (Ecclesiastes 1:7)

answers.answer: Snow and hail are stored in treasuries (storehouses)
answers.answerExplanation: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail, (Job 38:22)

question: What was the order of creation?

answers.answer: Genesis 1 order: light, sky, land/plants, sun/moon, sea creatures/birds, land animals, man and woman together

answers.answer: Genesis 2 order: man, garden/trees, animals, woman from man's rib

question: Was Moses meek or aggressive?

answers.answer: Moses was the meekest man on earth

answers.answer: Moses was wrathful and commanded killing

question: Do the righteous flourish or perish?

answers.answer: The righteous flourish
answers.answerExplanation: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon. (Psalms 92:12)

answers.answerExplanation: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth [it] to heart: and merciful men [are] taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil [to come]. (Isaiah 57:1)

question: Did Jesus preach his first sermon on a plain or a mountain?

answers.answer: On a mountain

question: What were Jesus' last words on the cross?

answers.answer: "My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?"

answers.answer: "Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit"

question: How many years of famine were offered as punishment for David's sin?

answers.answer: Seven years of famine

question: What is the genealogy of Jesus through David?

answers.answerExplanation:
Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel: (Exodus 24:9)

(Amos 9:1)

question: Is God cruel and destructive, or kind and merciful?

question: What was Jesus' prediction regarding Peter's denial?

question: How many beatitudes are in the Sermon on the Mount?

answers.answer: Nine beatitudes (Matthew's account)

Blessed [are] the poor in spirit: for their's is the kingdom of heaven. (Matthew 5:3)

Blessed [are] they that mourn: for they shall be comforted. (Matthew 5:4)

Blessed [are] the meek: for they shall inherit the earth. (Matthew 5:5)

Blessed [are] they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled. (Matthew 5:6)

Blessed [are] the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy. (Matthew 5:7)

Blessed [are] the pure in heart: for they shall see God. (Matthew 5:8)

Blessed [are] the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God. (Matthew 5:9)

Blessed [are] they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for their's is the kingdom of heaven. (Matthew 5:10)

question: How old was Jehoiachin when he began to reign?

question: Is marriage good or should it be avoided?
